why_stopped: The 200-caption hand audit found 30.5% of v5 captions fail to convey their register to a reader, so the v5 corpus is being discarded and regenerated with prompt v6 on gemini-3.5-flash. This gate was measuring data that will not be used. Fold 1 had already settled the question it existed to answer: with floor 0.201 and ceiling 0.773 the floor-to-ceiling range is 57 points against an MDE of 2.3 under 5-fold CV, so the detectability criterion passes comfortably. Folds 2 and 3 would have refined the third decimal and produced a full-corpus confusion matrix -- a paper artifact, not a decision input.
retained_because: The v5 -> v6 comparison is part of the write-up, so the abandoned corpus's ceiling is worth having on record rather than deleted.
